example_sentences_in_bangla: তার দগ্ধ কপালের কারণে সব পরিকল্পনা ব্যর্থ হয়ে গেল।
দগ্ধ কপাল নিয়ে জন্মেছে, তাই জীবন কঠিন।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to his ill-fated forehead, all plans failed.
Born with a burnt fate, life has been tough for him.
history: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali beliefs where the forehead (কপাল) symbolizes destiny, often linked to astrological markings; similar expressions like পোড়া কপাল reflect cultural views on predestined misfortune.
note: Related idioms include পোড়া কপাল, ফাটা কপাল, emphasizing superstitious notions of fate.
